subject: ex-qc-tqc-ising-data
summary: Independently checked Nayak et al. 0707.1889v2: Ising F is Eq50/PDF31; Majorana exchange and relative phase are Eq53/PDF32; absolute Ising phases are in III.C.2/PDF37. IV.A starts PDF52, so the original locator is inaccurate. Current batch28 source still has the inaccurate original locator; sector dimension2, H^2=I, unit-modulus phases and ratio i independently verified with current producer contract, manifest and actual F/R/tree suppliers. Original finding is confirmed, not false-positive, but remains escalated because outside producer source/manifest correction is not authorized by this dispatch. Local closure attempted by exact source verification; no additional mathematical prerequisite is missing. Required owner action: route batch28 locator/mirror repair and return current independent producer evidence. No closed repair or confidence is claimed.
